name: Sophia Feliciano
bio: Sophia Feliciano is an American actor based in London. She has flirted with acting all her life and now is seriously committed to the craft for it is no longer about the pressure of success and "making it." Simply put, acting is a privilege and gift that is ripe with joy and freedom, two things that are harder to to live out in adulthood. You will see her in The Beekeeper, an upcoming Jason Statham film, directed by David Ayer. She plays Kelli Krane, chief of staff, opposite Jemma Redgrave AKA Madame President. Her dream roles would involve her interests- history, the culinary arts, vintage fashion, and dance.

credits.title: The Hand That Feeds You
credits.overview: A bed-bound, morbidly obese man spends his days playing video games, watching movies and sexually assaulting his social carer. One fateful day, a seemingly harmless power cut leads to heinous consequences.

credits.title: TAWN-19
